name: Tree Navigation
summary: Tree Navigation. A keyboard-first wayfinding primitive that preserves orientation and current location.

lifecycle.compatibility: Available for controlled production evaluation; the contract may still be refined.
lifecycle.rationale: The hierarchical navigation contract remains beta while router integration patterns and manual assistive-technology evidence are completed.
knownLimitations: Consumers own router authorization, preloading, and failed-navigation feedback.
Deep trees require consumer validation for label overflow and mobile disclosure.
promotionCriteria: Public API, defaults, aliases and entrypoint ownership are reviewed.
SSR/hydration, keyboard, accessibility and visual evidence are linked.
Runtime scale limits and consumer testing contract are documented.
Migration impact is classified before lifecycle promotion.

api.name: items
api.description: Ordered item collection rendered by the composite widget.

api.name: selectedId
api.description: Stable id of the currently selected item.

api.name: expandedIds
api.description: Stable ids of the currently expanded hierarchical items.

api.name: ariaLabel
api.description: Accessible name used when visible content is not sufficient.

api.name: indent
api.description: Logical inline indentation applied for each hierarchical depth level.

api.name: showGuides
api.description: Controls whether the component applies the show guides behavior.

api.name: itemSelected
api.description: Notifies the consumer after the item selected interaction completes.

api.name: loadChildren
api.description: Requests children when an unloaded item is expanded or its failed request is retried.

keyboard: Arrow Up and Arrow Down move through visible enabled items.
Arrow Right expands or enters a branch; Arrow Left collapses or returns to its parent.
Home and End jump; typing moves to the next matching visible item; Enter activates.
notes: Every navigation item id is non-empty, stable, and unique.
Current location is distinct from focus and selection.
Expansion and hierarchy remain perceivable when labels overflow.
KERN avoids ambient browser globals in reusable runtime infrastructure.
Validate the consuming SSR/hydration route, locale, ids and overlay host.
Uses the shared deterministic KERN id service.

examples.title: Controlled product navigation tree

guidance.useWhen: Use Tree Navigation for hierarchical route or document wayfinding with expandable branches.
guidance.avoidWhen: Use Tree for selectable domain data and Menu for a short transient action hierarchy.

commonMistakes: Importing from an undeclared family path or a source implementation file.
Loading only tokens.css instead of the complete styles/kern.css component bundle.
Assuming the documentation SSR build replaces validation of the consuming application.
Every item id must be non-empty, unique and stable across updates.
checklist: Import the symbol from its documented owner entrypoint; do not use a deep source import.
Load @kern-ui/angular/styles/kern.css exactly once in the application's global styles.
Provide every required input and keep collection identities stable across updates.
Verify keyboard, focus, visible labels, invalid state, long text, RTL and 200% zoom.
Test the consuming SSR/hydration route when server rendering is enabled.
Use @kern-ui/angular/testing harnesses when a component-specific harness is available.
